title: CRM
description: Optional sales pipeline: prospects, leads, and opportunities. Quotes (bids) live under Quotes - not here, and not billing.
quotesVsCrmBanner: Quotes are bids. This CRM pipeline is optional and separate from the quotes book.

opportunities.title: No opportunities yet
opportunities.body: Track qualified sales pursuits here. Conversion to a project is an explicit step after a quote is accepted.

prospects.title: No prospects yet
prospects.body: Prospects are potential customers before they become clients.

leads.title: No leads yet
leads.body: Capture early interest before qualifying an opportunity.

followUp.title: Next action / follow-up
followUp.description: Set the next follow-up and due time. Opportunity notes stay on the record; the log below is a separate note history. No email is sent.
followUp.notesHint: Stored on the opportunity notes field. Use this for context; the next-action fields are the due reminder.
followUp.nextActionHint: Short label for the next call, visit, or wait. Distinct from general notes and from the notes log.
followUp.nextActionAtHint: Due date and time for the next follow-up. Expected start is the project start, not this due time.
followUp.expectedStartHint: Expected project start - not a follow-up due date.
followUp.stageHint: Moves the opportunity on the pipeline board. Won convert happens on Quotes, not here.
followUp.empty: No next action, follow-up notes, or expected start stored yet.

history.title: Notes and audit
history.description: Stored opportunity notes and audit events for this record. This is not a separate activity feed.
history.auditEmpty: No audit events for this opportunity.

opportunity.noteHint: Logged as a dated note on this opportunity. Does not send email.
opportunity.quoteNotBilling: Internal CRM sales quotes are not the customer bid. Use Quotes (bids) instead.
opportunity.productQuotesHint: Customer bids live in Quotes. Accept and convert there - this is not a second quote book.
opportunity.productQuotesEmpty: No product quote yet. Create one in Quotes.
opportunity.advancedInternalHint: These write crm_sales_quotes / crm_estimates. They are not the owner-facing bid.

convert.title: Convert via Quotes
convert.headline: Won work is created from a product quote
convert.description: Create and accept a quote under Quotes, then convert there. CRM sales quotes are not the customer bid.
convert.ctaHint: The owner-facing bid is /quotes (estimates). Convert after the customer accepts that quote.
convert.requiresAcceptedQuote: Accept a product quote before converting.
convert.requiresProductQuote: Create a quote under Quotes, then accept it. Convert happens on the quote - not from a CRM sales quote.
convert.useQuotesConvert: This opportunity has an accepted product quote. Convert it on the quote page to create the project.
convert.vatNote: VAT/tax is never treated as profit. The contract stores the commercial net amount.

errors.cannotConvertLost: Lost or cancelled opportunities cannot be converted
errors.cannotLoseConverted: Converted opportunities cannot be marked lost
errors.quoteNotAccepted: Only an accepted sales quote version can feed contract net amount
errors.quoteOpportunityMismatch: Sales quote does not belong to this opportunity
errors.acceptedQuoteRequired: An accepted product quote is required to convert
errors.useProductQuote: Create and accept a product quote at /quotes before converting
errors.quoteFinalized: Cannot add versions to a finalized sales quote
errors.cannotIssueVersion: Only draft sales quote versions can be issued
errors.cannotAcceptVersion: Only draft or issued sales quote versions can be accepted
